title: Nvidia seeks >$500B of outside AI capital
summary: Nvidia has preliminary agreements with Apollo, BlackRock, Blackstone, Brookfield, Goldman and KKR targeting more than $500B of outside capital for AI infrastructure.
connection_notes: Preliminary LP agreements beside the backstops already extended to neoclouds.

title: Google and Constellation nuclear deals
summary: Alphabet and Constellation Energy have a 20-year deal for 890 MW of new nuclear and a 15-year deal for 2.7 GW, supporting $4.3B of upgrades.
connection_notes: Nuclear power for Google, alongside other hyperscaler power contracts.

title: Vistra 207 MW data-center deal starts Q3 2027
summary: Vistra has a 20-year, 207 MW deal with New Era Energy & Digital starting in Q3 2027. Its data-center deals total about 4.2 GW.
key_number: 207 MW from Q3 2027; ~4.2 GW of deals
connection_notes: Data-center power contract. Reported Oct 26, with the start dated to Q3 2027.

title: US-Canada trade deal reportedly close
summary: A US-Canada trade deal is reportedly close, but there is no timeline. Trump said it is coming soon and Hassett said talks are gathering steam.
connection_notes: Same talks as the tariff-list changes. No date has been set.

title: Cellectar Waldenstrom filing targeted for H1 2027
summary: Cellectar reported an 87.5% response rate in a Phase 2b Waldenstrom study. Phase 3 and an accelerated-approval filing are targeted for H1 2027.
connection_notes: H1 2027 is the stated window, so the date is not pinned to a day.

title: MacroGenics lorigerlimab update targeted for H1 2027
summary: MacroGenics reported a 25% response rate in an interim Phase 2 of lorigerlimab in gynecologic cancer, with an update targeted for H1 2027.
connection_notes: H1 2027 is the stated window, so the date is not pinned to a day.

title: Delegations in Tehran to avert renewed fighting
summary: Qatari, Saudi, Pakistani and Turkish delegations are in Tehran to avert renewed fighting.
connection_notes: Diplomatic track opposite the Pentagon's post-midterm strike options. Oil and defense are the market read-through.

title: Cadence, Nucor, Whirlpool, Welltower after the close
summary: Cadence, Nucor, Whirlpool and Welltower report after the close on Oct 26.
connection_notes: Nucor is also in the Mexico steel-tariff talks.

title: GE Vernova reports before the open
summary: GE Vernova reports before the open on Oct 28.
connection_notes: Same week as the Fed, after the Oct 22 power selloff.

title: Oracle Investor Day
summary: Oracle holds its Investor Day on Oct 28.
connection_notes: Wednesday session. The balance sheet and the off-books chip idea are the setup.

title: Bank of Japan decision
summary: The Bank of Japan decides on Oct 30.
connection_notes: Same week as the Fed.

title: FDA decision: Summit ivonescimab
summary: The FDA decision date for Summit Therapeutics' ivonescimab is Nov 14.
connection_notes: Cancer antibody decision, tied to the broader oncology landscape.
